description: She wears a floor-length forest-green gown with a square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Gold knotwork borders decorate the neckline, shoulders, cuffs, waist and long skirt front. Round ornate gold brooches fasten short shoulder drapes. A decorated green-and-gold belt has a round metal clasp. A broad green wrap with matching gold knotwork edging and fine fringe rests around her forearms and hangs at the sides. A muted cream underdress appears at the lower front opening. A simple ring and dark brown closed leather shoes are visible.
